FROM payments.pos_payments pp

WHERE pp.tender = 'UPI'
  AND pp.ts >= '2026-06-01' AND pp.ts < '2026-07-01'

SELECT 
    pp.bill_id,
    pp.attempt,
    pp.tender,
    pp.till_status,
    pp.ts as till_ts,
    pu.status as upi_status,
    pu.status_ts as upi_status_ts
FROM payments.pos_payments pp

WHERE pp.tender = 'UPI'
  AND pp.ts >= '2026-06-01' AND pp.ts < '2026-07-01'
